items: A runtime still used by the current coding host must not be replaced; this preparation does not disconnect it.
A live backup is coherent only if the exact file set and hashes remain stable across copying and build preparation.
Historical temporary material was not found in accessible locations; access-denied locations prevent claiming global absence or deletion.
A wheel archive hash may differ while its exact staged payload stays identical; record both identities.
Temporary cleanup can remove recovery material later; this task records a discoverable basename and requires fresh verification before any later use.
